situations.title: 화재 삼각 요소 인지
situations.tagline: Before we start, let's make sure we're all aware of the oxygen, the Bovie, and the drapes as our fire triangle.
situations.brief: 산소 발화원 연료의 화재 삼각 요소를 팀과 함께 인지하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's identify our oxidizer, ignition source, and fuel.
High oxygen plus the Bovie is our main fire risk here.
Everyone should know where those three elements are.

situations.title: 산소 농도 확인
situations.tagline: Can we confirm what FiO2 the patient's running at before the surgeon starts cutting?
situations.brief: 수술 시작 전 고농도 산소 여부를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: What's the current oxygen concentration?
Can we lower the FiO2 if it's clinically safe?
Let's document the oxygen level before we begin.

situations.title: 소독제 건조 대기
situations.tagline: Let's give the alcohol prep the full three minutes to dry before we drape.
situations.brief: 알코올 소독제가 완전히 건조되도록 대기 시간을 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: The prep needs to be fully dry before draping.
Let's wait the full dry time the manufacturer recommends.
Flammable vapors linger if we rush this step.

situations.title: 소작기 안전 보관
situations.tagline: When the Bovie's not in use, let's keep it in the holster, not on the drapes.
situations.brief: 사용하지 않는 소작기를 holster에 안전하게 보관하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's return the cautery to its holster between uses.
An active tip on the drapes is a fire risk.
Keeping it holstered protects the whole field.

situations.title: 드레이프 산소 고임 방지
situations.tagline: Let's tent the drapes so oxygen doesn't build up around the surgical site.
situations.brief: 드레이프 아래 산소가 고이지 않도록 배치를 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's tent the drapes to prevent oxygen pooling.
Trapped oxygen under the drapes raises the fire risk.
Good airflow keeps the concentration down.

situations.title: 소화 도구 위치 확인
situations.tagline: Does everyone know where the saline and the fire extinguisher are before we start?
situations.brief: 화재 대응 도구의 위치를 팀과 함께 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's confirm where the saline and extinguisher are.
Everyone should know our fire response plan.
Knowing the location saves seconds in an emergency.

situations.title: 기도 수술 산소 저감
situations.tagline: For this airway case, can we bring the oxygen down before the surgeon uses cautery?
situations.brief: 기도 수술 시 화재 위험을 줄이기 위해 산소를 저감하세요.
keyPhrases: Airway cases carry a high fire risk with oxygen.
Can we titrate the FiO2 down before cautery?
Let's coordinate the oxygen level with the surgeon.

situations.title: 소독제 고임 제거
situations.tagline: There's some prep solution pooling under the patient's back — let's wick it out.
situations.brief: 환자 아래 고인 소독제를 제거해 화재 위험을 낮추세요.
keyPhrases: There's prep pooling under the patient.
Let's blot it out before we drape.
Pooled solution can ignite with cautery.

situations.title: 소작 전 산소 조정 요청
situations.tagline: Doctor's about to cauterize — can we confirm the oxygen's been adjusted first?
situations.brief: 소작 전 산소 농도 조정 여부를 팀과 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: Before cautery, let's confirm the oxygen level.
Can anesthesia adjust the FiO2 now?
Let's verbalize when the oxygen is safe.
goals: 팀 간 산소 상태를 명확히 소통한다

situations.title: 레이저 사용 화재 예방
situations.tagline: We're using the laser next — let's switch to laser-safe supplies and lower the oxygen.
situations.brief: 레이저 사용 시 안전 물품과 산소 관리로 화재를 예방하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's use laser-safe drapes and an appropriate tube.
Can we lower the oxygen before the laser fires?
Everyone should wear the right eye protection.

situations.title: 두경부 수술 산소 관리
situations.tagline: This is a head and neck case near the oxygen source — let's manage the FiO2 carefully.
situations.brief: 두경부 수술에서 얼굴 주변 산소를 세심하게 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Oxygen near the face raises the fire risk here.
Can we scavenge or lower the supplemental oxygen?
Let's keep the concentration as low as safely possible.

situations.title: 드레이프 아래 산소 환기
situations.tagline: Let's open up the drapes a bit so trapped oxygen can escape before cautery.
situations.brief: 드레이프 아래 고인 산소를 배출해 환기하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's ventilate under the drapes before we start.
Trapped oxygen needs a path to escape.
A minute of airflow lowers the concentration.

situations.title: 발화원 사용 팀 경고
situations.tagline: Heads up, everyone — surgeon's activating the Bovie now, so watch the field.
situations.brief: 발화원 사용 전 팀에게 명확히 고지하세요.
keyPhrases: Announcing: cautery is going active now.
Everyone, be aware the ignition source is in use.
Let's keep oxygen and fuel clear of the tip.

situations.title: 상체 고위험 부위 확인
situations.tagline: This incision's above the xiphoid, so we're in a high-risk zone for fire — let's be careful.
situations.brief: 상체 수술의 화재 고위험 부위를 팀과 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Surgery above the chest is higher fire risk.
Oxygen tends to collect near the head and neck.
Let's stay extra cautious with ignition here.

situations.title: 화재 위험 사전 평가
situations.tagline: During time-out, let's score this case's fire risk before we begin.
situations.brief: 수술 전 time-out에서 화재 위험을 사전 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's run our fire risk assessment now.
We have oxygen, an ignition source, and fuel — that's high risk.
Let's agree on our precautions before starting.

situations.title: 드레이프 발화 초기 대응
situations.tagline: The drape just caught — grab the saline, I'm smothering it now!
situations.brief: 드레이프에 불이 붙은 초기에 즉시 소화하세요.
keyPhrases: Fire on the drapes — pour saline now!
Smother it and pull the burning drape away.
Call it out so the whole team responds.

situations.title: 기도 화재 발생
situations.tagline: Airway fire — stop ventilation, disconnect the circuit, we need to act right now!
situations.brief: 기도 화재 발생 시 환기 중단과 회로 분리로 즉시 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Airway fire — stop the gas and disconnect the circuit!
Remove the tube and flood the field with saline.
Re-establish the airway once it's out.

situations.title: 환자 화상 화재 진화
situations.tagline: The patient's gown is burning — smother it, get the flames off the skin now!
situations.brief: 환자에게 붙은 불을 진화하고 화원에서 분리하세요.
keyPhrases: Smother the flames on the patient immediately.
Pull the burning material away from the skin.
Cool the area with saline once the fire's out.

situations.title: 산소 공급 즉시 차단
situations.tagline: Cut the oxygen — shut off the source now before this spreads!
situations.brief: 화재 시 산소 공급을 즉시 차단해 확산을 막으세요.
keyPhrases: Shut off the oxygen at the source immediately.
Cutting the oxidizer starves the fire.
Confirm the gas is off out loud.

situations.title: 화재 확산 대피 판단
situations.tagline: This is spreading past the field — do we evacuate the room or can we knock it down?
situations.brief: 화재 확산 상황에서 대피와 소화를 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: If we can't control it, we evacuate the patient.
Pull the alarm and call for help now.
Let's decide: contain it or clear the room.

situations.title: 화재 후 기도 손상 평가
situations.tagline: The fire's out — now we need to assess her airway for inhalation injury before transport.
situations.brief: 화재 후 흡입 손상 여부를 평가하고 상급팀에 연계하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's assess for airway burns and inhalation injury.
Watch for soot, stridor, or facial swelling.
We may need early intubation and ICU transfer.
